verses.1: May the words of Jehovah be fulfilled upon Israel. May Jehovah settle over the heavens and establish the earth. And may He create a soul within man’s body.
verses.2: Behold, I have set Jerusalem as a sign of peace for all the nations around it. And also, in Jerusalem itself, there will be a sign of peace for the Jews.
verses.3: And on that day, I will lay a stone of judgment over Jerusalem for all the nations. All those who live in it will be gathered there, and all the people of the earth will come together there.
verses.4: On that day, the Lord will say, “All horses in the land will be destroyed. Their riders will also be destroyed. I will open my eyes, and all horses of the nations will be destroyed.”
verses.5: And the elders of Judah said in their hearts, “May the inhabitants of Jerusalem be saved by the Lord, their God.”
verses.6: On that day, I will set up the altars of Judah like a fire in wood. I will kindle the fire in Amorai and Eshkol. All the nations around will be destroyed. And Jerusalem will still be under my rule.
verses.7: And Jehovah will save the tabernacles of the Jews in the past, so that the glory of David’s house and the glory of those who dwell in Jerusalem will not increase.
verses.8: On that day, the LORD will protect Jerusalem. Those who were defeated on that day will be like David and the house of David. The LORD will be like a God before them.
verses.9: And on that day, I will destroy all the nations that attack Jerusalem.
verses.10: And I poured out the breath of grace upon David’s house, and upon those who dwell in Jerusalem. They looked to me, for they had spoken evil of him, and described him in a negative light, just as one would describe a dead person.
verses.11: On that day, the sacrifice will be offered in Jerusalem, just as it was in Megiddo.
verses.12: And the land was divided into separate families: only the family of David remained alone, with their wives also being separate from those of the family of Nathan.
verses.13: The family of Bet-Levi alone, and their women alone, are different from the family of Shimi. Their women alone are different from those of Shimi’s family.
verses.14: All the families that remain are single-family households, and their wives are also single.
